name_en: Mikan Zushi — sushi rice seasoned with mikan juice instead of scarce vinegar
summary_ja: 米酢が貴重だった南予で、酸味の強いみかんやかぼすの果汁を合わせ酢代わりに使うちらしずし。売り物にならないみかんを使った「みかんご飯」が原型とされ、学校給食にも取り入れられている。
summary_en: In southern Ehime, where rice vinegar was once hard to come by, the tart juice of mikan or kabosu citrus stands in for vinegar in this scattered sushi. It's said to have grown out of "mikan rice," made with fruit too blemished to sell, and it now appears on school lunch menus too.
source_title: みかんずし 愛媛県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
